articles.title: Quantum could solve AI energy drain, says tech founder
articles.desc: Quantum computers could curb the vast energy demands of artificial intelligence data centres with their ability to run complex calculations, one of the tech's pioneers told AFP. Australian startup Diraq is conducting the first field test worldwide putting a small quantum computer based on a silicon chip in a commercial data centre in Sydney. Diraq's computer installed in Equinix's Sydney data centre has eight quantum bits, or qubits, on a silicon chip.

articles.title: AI demand unlikely to be derailed by Nvidia CEO controversy: Taiwan supply chain executives
articles.desc: Global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) is expected to remain strong despite the controversy surrounding Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, with Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain sources expecting limited long-term impact on the industry, according to a news report by Focus Taiwan.

articles.title: Australia to adopt 'mandatory' AI safeguards
articles.desc: Artificial intelligence companies will have to abide by new "mandatory" safeguards when operating in Australia, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Tuesday. With immense renewable energy potential and vast stretches of uninhabited land, Australia has billed itself as a prime location for the data centres needed to power artificial intelligence.

articles.desc: The US Justice Department sued Lyft on Monday, alleging the ride-hailing ​services provider discriminated against passengers with disabilities, including those who use service animals and mobility devices such as stowable wheelchairs.

The company aimed to sell approximately 867 million shares priced between $70 and $80 each. A follow-up email clarified that these pricing details were incorrect. Anthropic indicated that an updated filing would be provided later. The company has chosen not to provide further comments regarding the situation.

articles.title: RBI said to query bank valuations of some bond derivative trades
articles.desc: India's central bank has informed some lenders about the need to adjust bond forward accounting practices. This change could impact billions of dollars in assets across the banking sector. The Reserve Bank of India suggested using Level 3 inputs for valuing bond-forward trades during recent audits. Banks have been in discussions with industry associations and clearinghouses for potential solutions and better pricing information.

articles.title: Trump administration's embrace of "perp" futures sets off risk alarms for Wall Street stalwarts
articles.desc: The decision by the Trump administration to launch perpetual futures has sparked significant worry among market stakeholders. Leaders from established exchanges contend that these offerings might disrupt existing market dynamics and risk assessment practices. They claim that perpetual futures ought to be categorized as swaps due to their unique trading characteristics. Moreover, ongoing trading raises alarm about liquidity and counterparty risk, especially in turbulent market conditions.

Investors are eagerly awaiting the upcoming consumer price index data, a key factor for Federal Reserve rate considerations. Meanwhile, the euro and other currencies are rebounding against the dollar, backed by solid economic indicators.

Tech giants like Microsoft and Alphabet, along with chip manufacturers such as Marvell and Broadcom, enjoyed substantial gains.

Investors are now watching US and Indian inflation data for cues on the outlook for interest rates.

articles.title: Govt may extend support measures in FY28 Budget to boost manufacturing of 100 products: Official
articles.desc: The government may announce Budget 2027-28 support measures to boost domestic manufacturing of 100 products, including auto components, chemicals and machinery, to reduce import dependence. DPIIT has identified the products after consultations with ministries and industry.

articles.title: US market remains tied to tech stocks despite sharp AI sell-off
articles.desc: The US stock market is currently experiencing a significant pullback in technology and AI-related stocks. Investors are concerned that Democratic victories in the midterm elections may result in reduced data center spending. Despite recent declines, the technology sector remains dominant within the S&P 500 index. Upcoming technology earnings reports and the potential IPO of AI lab Anthropic are closely watched by investors.

articles.title: India's investment outlook strengthens as credit, exports rebound; inflation relief likely: HSBC
articles.desc: India's investment outlook is improving as credit growth and corporate revenue increase, pointing towards stronger private capital spending. The report from HSBC highlights that funds to the commercial sector have risen significantly compared to previous years. Additionally, rising services exports have helped maintain a steady current account deficit in the economy. However, challenges such as weak rural demand and inflation continue to impact households and corporate margins.

articles.title: FIIs cut stake in 10 smallcap stocks for 3 consecutive quarters; shares fall up to 70% in CY26
articles.desc: FIIs reduced stakes in 235 BSE smallcap companies for three consecutive quarters. Nine stocks suffered 50–70% declines in CY26, highlighting sustained foreign investor selling and significant market corrections.​

articles.title: Banks, investors grow wary of AI debt, spooked by market selloff
articles.desc: Some banks, which just a few weeks ago were lining up to fund AI deals, are now telling market participants they would be reluctant to finance additional deals even when they involve guarantees from the sector's marquee technology companies, according to several banking and credit sources.

articles.title: Indian rupee breaks six-day winning streak on state banks' dollar bids
articles.desc: The Indian rupee snapped its six-session winning streak on Monday, November 9, as dollar purchases by state-run banks outweighed positive momentum. The currency touched a six-month high of 93.69 per dollar before closing slightly lower at 93.9275. Lower crude oil prices and foreign equity inflows provided some support.

articles.title: Sarvam names Google Cloud India head Sashikumar Sreedharan as president & chief business officer
articles.desc: Sashikumar will additionally join Sarvam's board of directors. He will lead the company's business across enterprises and government, while expanding its engagement with digital-native companies, developers and partners.

articles.title: RBI's $239 bn forward dollar position to limit rupee gains despite FPI inflows: Report
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India currently has a net short position of USD 239 billion in the forward market, which may hinder the rupee's ability to strengthen, even as foreign portfolio investor inflows improve. This influx could potentially be managed by the Reserve Bank, capping any gains for the rupee against the US dollar.

articles.title: China dismisses spy plot claim involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang as smear campaign
articles.desc: Huang has acknowledged to the Nvidia board that he had been intimate with a business executive who US intelligence determined was gathering information for Beijing, according to The New York Times.

articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang, the scandal-hit AI visionary in a leather jacket
articles.desc: Chips made by US chip titan Nvidia push the boundaries of artificial intelligence, but its leader Jensen Huang is in the spotlight over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. That is an area of concern to US officials who believe he has been involved with the alleged spy, Alice Huang, who is linked to a Singapore-based data center company, according to the New York Times.

articles.title: MakeMyTrip's India arm gets Sebi nod to float IPO
articles.desc: MakeMyTrip's India subsidiary, MMT India, has received approval from Sebi for an initial public offering. This approval follows a confidential filing of draft papers made in July. The IPO will involve the sale of equity shares by MakeMyTrip and its subsidiary, ibibo Group Holdings. Proceeds from the sale are expected to enhance the cash position of the parent company.

articles.title: Indian bonds drift with oil; inflation data in focus
articles.desc: Indian government bonds exhibited limited movement today as oil prices showed signs of stabilization. Investors are remaining cautious, especially with inflation data from both the United States and India on the horizon. Scheduled for later today is a bond auction totaling 290.5 billion rupees. Analysts predict yields on the 10-year bond could oscillate between 7.30% and 7.10%, with particular attention on India's October inflation report due for release this Thursday.

articles.title: Explained: Why Nvidia shares dropped 4% in overnight trade and what analysts warn can trigger a bloodbath?
articles.desc: Nvidia shares dropped over 4% after CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged an affair with Alice Huang. Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice, a Chinese national, raised security concerns following intelligence reports. Nvidia has initiated an investigation into these allegations, although the board believes no secrets were compromised. Analysts suggest the company's upcoming earnings report will be crucial for market sentiment. Concerns linger over Huang's position if further evidence of wrongdoing emerges.
